steps.message: The bug was in `Style.clear_meta_and_links()` in `rich/style.py`, where the `_hash` attribute was being copied from the original style object. Since `_link` and `_meta` are cleared in this method and are part of the hash calculation, copying the hash resulted in an incorrect hash for the new style object. I fixed this by setting `style._hash = None` in `clear_meta_and_links()`, which forces the hash to be recalculated based on the updated attributes. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.
